summary: @dogtrax just realized why I see all your Mastodon poems. I have a poetry feed in my reader. I added the rss from Mastodon for small poems. I love the poetry community we have carved out but do it from your blog first. Ephemeral fun is fantastic but posting poetry should prioritize your own domain
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @dogtrax just realized why I see all your Mastodon poems. I have a poetry feed in my reader. I added the rss from Mastodon for small poems. I love the poetry community we have carved out but do it from your blog first. Ephemeral fun is fantastic but posting poetry should prioritize your own domain
